study: CST-DUST, prefix 1564, six within-lobe phase reversals

preparation.held_fixed: incoming pointwise intensity, both lobe supports and amplitudes, scalar preparation, all field measures, collar pairing, all history coefficients for each comparison

primary_endpoint: maximum over both densities and nonzero complex q of the ratio of unnormalized inclusive exterior squared norms, modulated / reference

decision.control: same seven intervals with positive signs; all 20 reference disks must overlap their archived disks
decision.PASS: complete qualified run, U_rho <= 1/100 for both densities
decision.FAIL: complete qualified run, L_rho > 1/100 for at least one density
decision.HOLD: incomplete data, invalid control or error budget, or an interval that leaves the joint decision unresolved

primary_analysis: score.py, qualified new complex disks from the seven-segment integration described in Protokoll.md
